Warframe is an excellent game. I have spent numerous hours playing this game and I'm barely halfway through the non-endgame content. I have some minor gripes, but considering how long I have been playing, I'd say that they are mostly negligible.

PROS: 
+ MASSIVE amount of content.
+ Easy to learn
+ Nearly endless skill ceiling
+ Excellent gameplay mechanics
+ All payment is optional

Digital Extremes have taken great care in creating a truly great experience.  I personally have very few issues with this game. However, there are some things that I'm sure will bother others. I'll list them here for you.

CONS*:
- CAN get samey
- Requires a LOT of time investment
- Paying for items has the potential to extremely be expensive
- No dedicated servers (Matchmaking with random people can result in severe latency issues)

Personally, I only have issues with the matchmaking. There are many opportunities to get large discounts on ingame currency, and the levels are randomly generated based on tilesets (Rooms are the same, but the layouts are random). 

Overall, if you have plenty of free time and are okay with levels feeling similar, I HIGHLY recommend this game. Basically, to sum it up, take Destiny, get rid of randomly-generated weapons, give it an interesting story, deep combat mechanics, and memorable character design.

That is warframe.

Its an ok game. its not bad. there are may worse games out there, and to be honest, this one is actualy kind of fun. you dont need very much skill to be good at it, and it really is a pay to win game, but even if you dont, that just means it'll take about 10 times as long to  do stuff. i wont harp on that though, as most games are like that anyway. the graphics are really good, the environments are well thought out, and no two maps are the same, because every map is randomly generated. the AI is pretty ♥♥♥♥, but they make up for it with insane accuracy. the warframes are also fun to mess around with, and the wepons are cool. this isnt a game i recommend if you want a challenge, i recomend this game to people who want to beat the living hell out of thousands of underpowerd enimes while using superpowers like lightning, fire, wind, death itself,  or a shrukin (suprised me to).
